svg.text: JACQUARD DELIKLI KARTI VE DOKUNMUS MOTIF ESLEMESI
PUNCHED HOLE (1) = WARP THREAD RAISED | UNPUNCHED CARDBOARD (0) = WARP DOWN | DIRECT DATA BUS
Punching 1-bit holes converts woven geometry directly into hardware memory.
Zero deviation across infinite repeats: textile structure as executable code.
